text: Fun way of staying focused!
author: A Google user

text: If you really want a minimal app to help cut down screen time, please check out "Forest: Stay focused". This "Focus Plant" game is as much "for phone addiction" as Clash of Clans is. The only difference is the plant theme and a timer you set for resource generation. For an app that claims to help with phone addiction, there is an unfortunately time-consuming and extensive game to dive into right after each focus session. This game employs a lot of the casino/psychology gamification tactics that addicting games thrive off of. You're just trading apps to get addicted to. If you want an app that's basically setting a timer for when you'll be notified to play a game designed specifically to be time consuming, this app might be for you. The tiniest of 'progress' in the game requires tons of tapping, upgrading, resource generation, extensive game mechanics to get lost in, and within only a couple of focus sessions you're spreading your time and resources across many screens that require even more tapping, upgrading, resource generation, etc. I'd give it five stars if the game didn't pretend to be for phone addiction and just admitted it was a time-consuming game. As a game it's very cute and well designed, but claiming to be helpful for phone addiction while clearly being designed to be time consuming and addictive is a misleading way to describe it.
author: A Google user
developer_reply: Hi, thank you for your feedback. Please share with us that which part of the game you think is too time consuming as we've been trying to keep the 'play time' minimal? The game is designed to psychological stimulate players, in other words, make the game addictive so that our players will keep coming back to focus as it's the only way to progress.
